# Rehabs.org

> > Comprehensive addiction treatment directory and recovery resource connecting individuals with rehab facilities, medication-assisted treatment programs, and evidence-based recovery information.

Rehabs.org provides detailed profiles of addiction treatment centers across the United States, educational guides on treatment modalities including CBT and medication-assisted treatment (methadone, buprenorphine), and current news affecting the recovery community. The site covers specialized programs for adolescents, dual diagnosis, and co-occurring disorders.

## Key Topics

- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Residential Rehab Programs
- Outpatient Treatment
- Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP)
- Detox Services
- Dual Diagnosis & Co-Occurring Disorders
- Adolescent Treatment Programs
- 12-Step Recovery (AA)
- Methadone & Buprenorphine
- Medicare & Medicaid Coverage
- Joint Commission Accreditation
- Opioid Addiction Treatment
- Behavioral Therapy
- Sober Living

## Treatment Facilities Directory

- [Safe Step Communities | Westland, MI](https://rehabs.org/safe-step-communities): Safe Step Communities rehab facility in Westland, MI offering CBT
- [Orchard Mountain Recovery | Charlottesville, VA](https://rehabs.org/orchard-mountain-recovery): Orchard Mountain Recovery outpatient program in Charlottesville, VA
- [Spokane Comprehensive Treatment Center | Spokane, WA](https://rehabs.org/spokane-treatment-solutions): Spokane facility offering medication-assisted opioid treatment
- [Synergy Recovery | North Wilkesboro, NC](https://rehabs.org/synergy-recovery): Synergy Recovery residential rehab with detox in North Wilkesboro, NC
- [Oceanside Malibu | Malibu, CA](https://rehabs.org/oceanside-malibu): Oceanside Malibu luxury oceanfront rehab with medically-supervised detox
- [Southwest Florida Men's Rehab | Fort Myers, FL](https://rehabs.org/southwest-florida-mens-rehab): Christian men's long-term inpatient rehab in Fort Myers, FL
- [MeadowWood Behavioral Health Hospital | New Castle, DE](https://rehabs.org/meadowwood-behavioral-health-hospital): MeadowWood Hospital offering inpatient and partial hospitalization in DE
- [Starview Community Center | El Monte, CA](https://rehabs.org/starview-community-center): Starview youth and adolescent behavioral health services in El Monte, CA
- [Advantage Behavioral Health Systems Jackson County | Jefferson, GA](https://rehabs.org/advantage-behavioral-health-systems-3): Advantage Behavioral Health outpatient services in Jefferson, GA
- [The Doorway to Recovery | Livonia, MI](https://rehabs.org/the-doorway-to-recovery): The Doorway to Recovery inpatient and outpatient rehab in Livonia, MI
- [Amended Recovery House | Hollywood, FL](https://rehabs.org/amended-recovery-house): Amended Recovery sober living and outpatient treatment in Hollywood, FL

## Treatment Program Guides

- [How Does Outpatient Rehab Work?: What to Expect](https://rehabs.org/treatment/outpatient-rehab): Guide to outpatient rehab programs and intensive treatment options
- [Specialized Addiction Treatment: Why it is Important](https://rehabs.org/treatment/specialized-programs): Guide to specialized treatment for dual diagnosis and co-occurring disorders
- [12 Promises of Alcoholics Anonymous (AA)](https://rehabs.org/aa-promises): Guide to the 12 Promises of AA from the Big Book Chapter 6

## Recovery Questions & Support

- [What's a Typical Day in Rehab Like?](https://rehabs.org/questions/typical-day-in-rehab): FAQ explaining daily schedule and therapy approaches in inpatient rehab

## Addiction News & Community

- [Blog](https://rehabs.org/community): Recovery blog covering addiction topics, GLP-1 medications, and stories
- [Most Outpatient Mental Health Clinics Don't Offer Opioid Addiction Meds](https://rehabs.org/news/most-outpatient-mental-health-clinics-dont-offer-opioid-addiction-meds): JAMA study on limited MAT availability at outpatient mental health centers
- [For Many, Dry January Is Becoming Sober 2025](https://rehabs.org/news/dry-january-is-becoming-sober-2025): Dry January sobriety trends extending into year-long commitments
- [Largest Fentanyl Bust in Delaware History](https://rehabs.org/news/largest-fentanyl-bust-in-delaware-history): Dwayne Fountain sentencing for Delaware's largest fentanyl seizure
- [Boston Drug and Homelessness Crisis Dominates Mayor Race](https://rehabs.org/news/boston-drug-and-homelessness-crisis-dominates-mayor-race): Boston mayoral race focused on Mass and Cass homelessness crisis
